# GitHub Copilot instructions
Read `AGENTS.md` and the relevant `skills/*/SKILL.md` before generating code. The application is Polish-language iOS React Native + Expo, local SQLite, offline-first and without backend in MVP. Financial domain rules in `docs/02-domain.md` override any inferred conventions. Design follows `docs/04-design-system.md`; the Stitch CSS is not valid React Native code. Write tests using `docs/07-acceptance-tests.md`. Keep planned, posted and valuation data separate. Never classify transfers between own accounts or BLIK investment deposits as consumer expenses.
